description_expanded:
Vacation rental guests will enjoy this beautiful and newly constructed 3-bedroom home located directly next to the Caliza pool complex. The first level features a large and private courtyard with ample seating, built-in grill and an amazing outdoor fire pit. Also on this level guests will find the laundry room, kitchen with a large center island and butler’s pantry as well as a spacious family room with a glass-enclosed fireplace and dining area with plenty of natural light. The spacious primary suite with private outdoor shower is also located on the first level. Moving to the second floor, guests will find two bedrooms, each with one queen-sized bed and private bath. A separate bunk room with one upper and one lower bed completes the second level. Parking for this home is located in a two-car attached garage. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding 37 Featherbed Alley. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
